Subject: User-journey capture — 30m discovery interview (recording consent)

Hi Sana / Oliver,

Thanks again for agreeing to be a reference — we really appreciate Insight Health's partnership. As a first step we'd love to run a short 30-minute discovery interview to capture a user journey / case study narrative. The objective: understand why you selected Redwood, the primary uses, and measurable outcomes so we can draft a case study that you can review.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 5m introductions & goals
- 10m user journey + who does what
- 10m outcomes, metrics, and ROI examples
- 5m next steps & approvals

Attachments: 20270411-discovery_agenda.pdf (PDF)

Would any of these slots next week work for you?
- Tue Apr 13: 10:00 — 10:30 AM PT
- Wed Apr 14: 1:00 — 1:30 PM PT
- Thu Apr 15: 11:00 — 11:30 AM PT

We'd like to record the session so we can accurately capture quotes and callouts — attached is a short consent text. If that's a problem, we can take notes instead. Please let me know who from your team will join (you mentioned a PM) and which slot works best.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
